name: Demanding Agent
description: {driver}'s new agent is aggressive about contract terms, pushing for maximum pay.

name: Contract Dispute
description: {driver} is in a prolonged contract standoff that has created friction with the team.

name: Media Controversy
description: {driver} made controversial comments in the press that alienated fans.

name: Wealthy Patron
description: {driver} attracted a wealthy backer who's funding their career — no strings attached.

name: Street Racing Ban
description: {driver} was banned from street racing activities and is revaluating their priorities.

name: Veteran Wisdom
description: {driver} has accumulated enough experience to manage their driving more intelligently.

name: Key Engineer Poached
description: {driver}'s trusted race engineer was poached by a rival team.

name: Brand Ambassador
description: {driver} signed a lucrative brand ambassador deal and has developed a taste for corporate life.

name: Rival Team Interest
description: Rumours of interest from a rival team have made {driver} restless at their current outfit.

name: Sponsor Pressure
description: {driver}'s personal sponsor is demanding better results, creating unwanted pressure.

name: Team Boss Feud
description: {driver} fell into a bitter personal feud with their team principal. It started over a parking spot. It's now about everything.

name: National Hero
description: {driver} became a national hero and is now on a postage stamp. Their mum has bought three hundred of them.

name: Pay Driver Stigma
description: {driver} has been labelled a 'pay driver' by the media, regardless of ability. The chip on their shoulder is growing.

name: Mentor Role
description: {driver} took a young academy driver under their wing and is increasingly focused on legacy over raw results.

name: Gambling Debts
description: {driver} accumulated significant gambling debts and is desperately negotiating for a bigger contract.

name: Crypto Disaster
description: {driver} enthusiastically endorsed a cryptocurrency that immediately crashed 98%. The memes were merciless.

name: Reality TV Star
description: {driver} appeared on a reality TV dating show. They didn't find love but gained two million followers and a questionable catchphrase.

name: Drivers' Union Rep
description: {driver} became the unofficial drivers' union representative, fighting for better conditions, longer breaks, and nicer catering.

name: Press Conference Nap
description: {driver} fell asleep during a live press conference. The clip went viral and somehow made them more popular than ever.

name: Fired Agent Live
description: {driver} fired their agent in spectacular fashion during a live Instagram stream. They're now handling negotiations themselves, poorly.

name: Honorary Degree
description: {driver} received an honorary doctorate from a prestigious university and now insists everyone calls them 'Doctor'.

name: Team Shareholder
description: {driver} bought a small share in their team. They're now significantly more invested in the team's success — literally.
